title: Musical Question · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Musical Question · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a short familiar two-part tune known to both players. The lead hums the first part and the partner hums the next part. The partner continues with the agreed second part. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Musical Question, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The partner continues with the agreed second part.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The partner continues with the agreed second part.
